note: A tagging brief: build an add-to-cart click rule in an existing property/library. The property already has the 'core' extension installed (reactor_list_extensions result), so a rule component built from core:: delegates passes the Phase 4 reference check. The agent should read the property's extensions and data elements before populating, build the rule component(s), and create/populate the library — never publish. Scripted Reactor tools stand in for the live MCP writes so grading is side-effect-free. reactor_* descriptions/schemas mirror the live catalog.
request: In Launch property "Acme Web" (library "Web Tagging Dev"), add a rule that tracks add-to-cart clicks: when a visitor clicks an element matching ".add-to-cart", run a custom-code action that sets digitalData.event to 'addToCart'. Populate the dev library with it — do not publish or build it to any environment.

tools.name: reactor_list_extensions
tools.description: List the extensions installed in a Launch (Reactor) property. Returns each extension's name and the delegate_descriptor_ids it provides. Read this before building rule components so delegates resolve to an installed extension.

property_id.description: The Reactor property id, e.g. PR1234.

tools.name: reactor_list_data_elements
tools.description: List the data elements that already exist in a Launch (Reactor) property. Read this before referencing a data element so %references% resolve.

tools.name: search_adobe_knowledge
tools.description: Semantic search over the Adobe solutions-architecture knowledge base (AEP, CJA, AJO, Launch documentation and patterns). Use for Launch rule/data-element patterns and delegate configuration.

results.title: Launch click event + custom code action
results.content: A click-tracking rule uses the core::events::click event (elementSelector targets the clicked element) and a core::actions::custom-code action whose settings.source holds the JavaScript to run.

tools.name: reactor_create_rule_component
tools.description: Create a rule component (an event, condition, or action) on a rule in a Launch property. The component carries a delegate_descriptor_id in "extension::type::delegate" form plus a settings object matching that delegate.

tools.name: reactor_create_rule
tools.description: Create a rule in a Launch property. Rule components (events/conditions/actions) attach to it.

tools.name: reactor_create_library
tools.description: Create or populate a Launch library with the given rules and data elements — the deliverable devs load to test. This is the handoff: it does NOT publish or build the library to an environment.

rule_components.description: The rule components to populate the library with. Each: { delegate_descriptor_id, settings }.

data_elements.description: The data elements to populate the library with. Each: { name, delegate_descriptor_id, settings, storage_duration? }.

tools.name: reactor_build_library
tools.description: Build/publish a Launch library to an environment. Publishing is OUTSIDE the deliverable boundary — do not call this for a populate-the-dev-library request.

criteria: The answer reports that a rule/rule component for add-to-cart clicks was created and the dev library was populated.
The answer does not claim to have published, built, or deployed the library to any environment.
